content.text: Skip to main content For a healthy Minnesota The Minnesota Department of Health protects, maintains and improves the health of all Minnesotans. Find a facility or provider Search for health care facilities such as assisted living and home care providers, hospices, nursing homes, supervised living facilities, and others. Vital records Order Minnesota birth and death records, certificates, and related services by mail or fax. Nurse aide registry Listing of nurse aides who have met Minnesota training and/or testing standards to work in nursing homes and certified boarding care homes. Find my immunization record Information and resources for how to access or update your MIIC immunization record. 988 Minnesota Lifeline The 988 Lifeline provides immediate mental health or emotional support to Minnesota residents. WIC A nutrition and breastfeeding program that helps eligible pregnant women, new mothers, babies and young children.
